assertion_results.text: Each non-documentation, non-testing task file contains all required template sections: Repository, Target Branch, Description, at least one of Files to Modify or Files to Create, Implementation Notes, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements. Documentation tasks (tasks whose filename or description indicates doc-only scope) and testing tasks (tasks whose filename or description indicates cross-cutting testing scope) are exempt from requiring Files to Modify, Files to Create, and Implementation Notes — they must still include Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements
assertion_results.evidence: Implementation tasks 1-4 (task-1-severity-summary-service.md, task-2-advisory-summary-endpoint.md, task-3-cache-invalidation-on-ingestion.md, task-4-threshold-query-param.md) all contain ## Repository, ## Target Branch, ## Description, ## Files to Modify, ## Implementation Notes, ## Acceptance Criteria, ## Test Requirements (tasks 1-2 also have ## Files to Create). Doc task 5 and testing tasks 6-7 contain Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements.

assertion_results.text: Task count is between 3 and 12 inclusive
assertion_results.evidence: 7 task files (task-1 through task-7); task-creation-log.md lists TC-9101..TC-9107.

assertion_results.text: Task dependencies form a DAG with no circular dependencies
assertion_results.evidence: Dependencies: 1 none; 2->1; 3->2; 4->2; 5,6,7->1,2,3,4. No cycles (impact-map 'Planned tasks' table and task Dependencies sections agree).

assertion_results.text: Every task's Files to Modify and Files to Create reference paths plausible within the repo-backend.md structure
assertion_results.evidence: Modified paths (modules/fundamental/src/sbom/model/mod.rs, sbom/service/sbom.rs, sbom/endpoints/mod.rs, tests/api/sbom.rs, modules/ingestor/src/graph/advisory/mod.rs, modules/ingestor/src/service/mod.rs, tests/api/advisory.rs) all appear in repo-backend.md; created files (sbom/model/advisory_summary.rs, sbom/endpoints/advisory_summary.rs) sit in existing directories following the module pattern.

assertion_results.text: Impact map lists concrete, specific changes (not vague or abstract descriptions)
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md changes include 'Add GET /api/v2/sbom/{id}/advisory-summary endpoint, returning 404 for an unknown SBOM ID', 'Add an AdvisorySeveritySummary response model { critical, high, medium, low, total }', 'using the existing sbom_advisory join table', plus a table of concrete file paths.

assertion_results.text: Every generated task description contains a Repository section with a single repository name (not multiple repos per task)
assertion_results.evidence: All 7 task files have '## Repository' followed only by 'trustify-backend'.

assertion_results.text: Every generated task description contains Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements sections as required by the handoff contract in task-description-template.md
assertion_results.evidence: All 7 task files contain ## Target Branch, ## Description, ## Acceptance Criteria, ## Test Requirements.

assertion_results.text: File paths in Files to Modify and Files to Create reference paths from the repo-backend.md mock repository structure manifest, not invented paths
assertion_results.evidence: All Files to Modify paths exist verbatim in the repo-backend.md directory tree; Files to Create are new files placed under existing manifest directories (modules/fundamental/src/sbom/model/, modules/fundamental/src/sbom/endpoints/). No paths outside the manifest structure.

assertion_results.text: Implementation Notes in every non-documentation, non-testing task reference specific file paths and code patterns from the repository, not abstract or generic guidance. Documentation tasks and testing tasks are exempt from this requirement as they intentionally omit Implementation Notes
assertion_results.evidence: Task 1 notes cite entity/src/sbom_advisory.rs, entity/src/advisory.rs, SeaORM select_only/count_distinct, common/src/error.rs; Task 2 mirrors modules/fundamental/src/sbom/endpoints/get.rs and tower-http caching; Task 3 hooks the correlate step in modules/ingestor/src/graph/advisory/mod.rs; Task 4 uses Axum Query extractor in advisory_summary.rs and severity type from advisory/model/summary.rs.

assertion_results.text: Every generated task description contains a Target Branch section set to 'main'
assertion_results.evidence: All 7 task files: '## Target Branch\nmain'. Impact map: 'Selected mode: direct-to-main ... All tasks target main'.

assertion_results.text: For each task created, a description digest is produced — evidenced by a separate digest file (e.g., task-N-digest.md), a digest entry in the impact map, or a '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:<64-char-hex>' marker in any output file. The digest must contain a format-tagged SHA-256 hash — exactly 64 lowercase hex characters prefixed by 'sha256-md:' or 'sha256-adf:'
assertion_results.evidence: task-1-digest.md through task-7-digest.md each contain '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:<64 lowercase hex>', e.g. task-1: sha256-md:89627fa408893894042f442b72e94d60d4c0d8db11a39fffa9f7a46f91aec5c8.

assertion_results.text: Convention-aware enrichment validates file-type applicability per shared/convention-applicability-rules.md before including a convention — inapplicable conventions are excluded entirely (not listed with 'Not applicable' annotations), and applicable ones include a rationale in the prescribed format ('Applies: task modifies <file> matching the convention's <scope>'), not free-form prose
assertion_results.evidence: Every convention line uses the format, e.g. Task 2: 'Applies: task modifies `modules/fundamental/src/sbom/endpoints/mod.rs` matching the convention's endpoint-registration scope.'; Task 3: 'Applies: task modifies `tests/api/advisory.rs` matching the convention's integration-test scope.' grep for 'Not applicable'/'N/A' across outputs returns nothing.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: Feature fixture Priority: Major. impact-map.md: 'Priority: Major (inherited by all tasks)' and additional_fields '"priority": {"name": "Major"}'; task-creation-log.md applies the same to every create call.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: Feature Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.5.0; scope 'both'. impact-map.md: 'Fix Versions: RHTPA 1.5.0 (inherited by all tasks; fixVersion scope: both)' and '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 1.5.0"}]'; task-creation-log.md same for all calls.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: No summary-comment.md exists, but impact-map.md has a 'Fields set on created issues (additional_fields)' section: 'priority: inherited from Feature ("Major" — set, not "Undefined") → propagated' and 'fixVersions: Feature has RHTPA 1.5.0; fixVersion scope: both → propagated'.

assertion_results.text: A documentation task is generated because the feature description's Documentation Considerations section indicates doc impact (Updates — add endpoint to REST API reference). The documentation task includes Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements, and Dependencies sections, and omits Files to Modify, Files to Create, API Changes, Implementation Notes, Reuse Candidates, and Verification Commands
assertion_results.evidence: task-5-api-reference-docs.md ('Doc impact type: Updates to existing content — add the endpoint to the REST API reference') has exactly Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements, Dependencies; none of the excluded sections present.

assertion_results.text: Testing tasks are generated from the testing readiness template — exactly 2 testing tasks are created (one per test category: Smoke Tests and Performance Benchmarks). Each testing task includes Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements, and Dependencies sections, and omits Files to Modify, Files to Create, API Changes, Implementation Notes, Reuse Candidates, and Verification Commands
assertion_results.evidence: task-6-smoke-tests.md (category 'Smoke Tests') and task-7-performance-benchmarks.md (category 'Performance Benchmarks'), both derived from docs/testing-readiness.md; each has only Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements, Dependencies.

assertion_results.text: Each testing task depends on all implementation tasks (not on documentation or other testing tasks)
assertion_results.evidence: Tasks 6 and 7 Dependencies list Task 1, 2, 3, 4 (all implementation tasks) and not Task 5 (docs) or each other.
